propositions: Four read-only git-derivable metrics (module_size_distribution, cap_change_events, churn, refactor_to_addition_ratio) must be implemented as deterministic functions in git_metrics.py scanning git history and the working tree against a single-sourced hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt

Each metric function must be wrapped in a single-arg compute adapter and registered into the c085 REGISTRY with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and accruing_since='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'

module_size_distribution must scan src/rebar/**/*.py at a given ref, returning exact counts of total modules, near-cap modules (within 10%), over-cap modules, and max line count; cap_change_events must return a list of commits where .github/module-size-limit.txt changed, with old and new limits
churn must sum insertions and deletions from git log --numstat; refactor_to_addition_ratio must return deletions/insertions or None when total insertions is zero

Unit tests must validate module_size_distribution, churn, cap_change_events, and refactor_to_addition_ratio against temp git repos with fixture modules and commits, asserting exact values and return types
All four git metrics must be present and correctly labeled in REGISTRY with the specified lens, source, and confidence values
